overview_description.description:
Gloat is the first-ever Internal Talent Marketplace, used by the world’s leading enterprises. Gloat enables enterprises to harness the hidden potential of talent throughout the organization by matching people's skills and aspirations to internal career opportunities that are right for them and provides mission-critical organizational agility, visibility, and insights.

Gloat is deployed at some of the most respected brands in the world with global deployments in over 120 countries across Unilever, PepsiCo, Standard Chartered Bank, Schneider Electric, Nestlé, HSBC, Seagate and many more.
